instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/frame_blank.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/frame_blank.step. Cut a centered 110 x 60 mm through window from the plate to form a rectangular frame. Add one 12 x 12 x 20 mm post at each of the four outside corners, with post bottom faces aligned to the original plate bottom face. Cut one through hole of diameter 4 mm through the center of each post. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
